title: The family's distances and why they won't move
summary: Carmen works in Boston and Junior in Los Angeles; Fields and his wife stay in Tulsa.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: She says that she's so far, we just seem to be in the middle of America and she's a little farther from us than Ernie Jr. and he mentioned even sometime that the way it it, he can fly and visit Carmen cheaper than he can fly home.
No, he hasn't, but he said he could, he just don't get time, but he said he could go to New York or Boston cheaper than he could go to Tulsa.
Would you and your wife contemplate moving possibly?
No. It's too far, we're kind of established there and with what I have we can get along better. It costs too much to move now, the way the economy is now.
And you love your home area, like I love Omaha.
